name: ojg-bounded-jsonpath-evaluation
instr:
ojg cannot bound and resume expensive JSONPath extraction without repeating observable work or results. Add uniform limits and continuations to materialized evaluation, mutation, token streaming, and the oj command while preserving unlimited behavior.

Zero means unlimited work and matches. Negative values return `ErrInvalidLimits` before effects. Charge each fragment one decision before every independently attempted selection, resuming after the last completed decision. `Report` counts decisions and fully delivered matches and distinguishes completion from exhaustion. Never repeat decisions, predicates, procedure calls, or matches.

Treat procedure invocation and ordered result delivery as one resumable decision stream. Each invocation consumes one decision, even with no results. Resume at the returned-element position without invoking the procedure again. Preserve wildcard order, recursive frontiers, negative indexes, procedure-result positions, and `GetWithLimits` order. Partitioned and unlimited evaluation must agree exactly.

A portable `Cursor` is bound to its expression and root shape. `ParseCursor`, incompatible cursors, and completed cursors return `ErrInvalidCursor` before examining data or causing effects.

`Expr.Evaluate`, `Expr.Resume`, `Expr.GetWithLimits`, `Expr.LocateWithLimits`, and `Expr.WalkWithLimits` must share accounting, normalized paths, completed values, and node-tail semantics.

`Expr.RemoveWithLimits` and `Expr.ModifyWithLimits` must be atomic on ex
